name: StepFlanger
description: Tempo-synced sample-and-hold flanger on AUDIO IN. Y is dual around center: distance sets LFO depth, sign sets feedback polarity (up = +, down = −). STEPS redraws random feedback amount; LFO is a separate tempo-synced sweep cycle. X = base delay. Hold the pad to engage; release returns to dry.

params.name: DEPTH
params.detail: Bipolar around center: |Y| = LFO depth, sign(Y) × step-random = feedback (+ up / − down)

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Dry/wet while the pad is held

params.name: SLEW
params.detail: How quickly feedback glides to each new random value
